summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made):**  The watchlist path is actually well-scoped end to end — client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`) has no localStorage/anonymous fallback, all requests go through `api.ts` with `credentials: "include"`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` requires a valid session cookie and injects `X-User-Id`, and every read/write query filters by `user_id`. So the "obvious" bugs the ticket predicted (missing session check, anonymous fallback, hardcoded watchlist_id) don't appear to exist in the current code.
